title: Asked Someone and Follow-Up Mentions
summary: This topic is a loose mix of recommendation wording, contact or follow-up mentions, and isolated conversational fragments, with most examples too incomplete to support a clear sentiment reading.

positive.summary: Positive reviews mention recommending the car, comfort when riding in it, or openness to speaking with BMW.

negative.summary: Negative feedback centers on expecting BMW to make contact about an issue and being dissatisfied that this follow-up did not happen.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments are mostly too short or context-free to interpret clearly, though some mention being passed around, delayed inspection, washing the car, or hypothetical comments about comfort and surprises.

limitations: The topic cluster mixes several unrelated subjects rather than one coherent aspect.
Most fragments are very short or lack surrounding context, so sentiment and specific issues are often unclear.
Examples are insufficient to draw a more precise theme beyond generic asking, someone, or yes phrasing.
